planets.name: HAT-P-11 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HAT-P-11 with a 4.89-day year, found in 2010.

text.card: HAT-P-11 b crosses its star every 4.89 days and is 0.45 Jupiter radii across, found in 2010.
text.introduction: HAT-P-11 b transits HAT-P-11 every 4.89 days and is 0.45 Jupiter radii across. Orbit and size follow An et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname AN_ET_AL__2025): pl_orbper 4.888, pl_radj 0.4466, pl_bmassj 0.0787

quotes.title: HAT-P-11b
quotes.card: HAT-P-11b is an extrasolar planet orbiting the star HAT-P-11.
quotes.introduction: It was discovered by the HATNet Project team in 2009 using the transit method, and submitted for publication on 2 January 2009.
